role: Unit tests validating thread-safety fixes for frame_sequence locking, IoUTracker public API, and embedding extractor double-checked locking.
detail: Three test classes validate critical concurrency fixes: (1) TestFrameSequenceLock verifies asyncio.Lock prevents duplicate frame_sequence numbers in concurrent /detect requests via 50 concurrent increments producing 1..50 unique monotonic values. (2) TestIoUTrackerPublicApi validates IoUTracker.get_active_track_count() returns int matching len(_tracks), not the internal list. (3) TestEmbeddingExtractorDoublCheckedLocking confirms threading.Lock-based double-checked locking initializes OnnxEmbeddingExtractor exactly once under 20 concurrent threads; includes a demonstrative no-lock test showing the race window. All tests use mocking (MagicMock, AsyncMock) and pytest.mark.asyncio for async test cases.
gotchas: TestEmbeddingExtractorDoublCheckedLocking.test_no_lock_shows_the_race is intentionally racy and non-deterministic; does not assert on init_count for that reason. This is documentation-only. Detection bbox values hardcoded in test (10.0, 100.0, 200.0). Uses time.sleep() for race simulation which may be unreliable.
